text:
devin: hey team — starting a thread to align infra/runtime/console on the per-route SLO dashboards we promised. goal: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT, and tokens/sec per model+route. need to lock metric names + tags and who owns ingest/retention.

maria: thanks. fwiw product wants route-level SLOs surfaced in Console with rollout-aware filters (canary vs prod). important: show both absolute latency and latency normalized by tokens.

ravi: infra concern: current runtime emits latency histograms by model_id only. we can emit route_id but it adds cardinality. can we standardize on route_id + model_family (coarse) + env?

sam: @ravi cardinality is real, but route-level SLOs are required. propose adding a low-cardinality tag set: `route_id` (hashed short id), `model_family`, `env`, `rollout_id` (nullable). drop user_id/tenant in metrics.

ravi: that works. also need to know expected QPS per route so we can provision and set sampling for histogram buckets. any list?

maria: we can provide top-200 routes from Console usage logs — will send CSV. for medium tail we can rely on sampling.

elaine: console-ux asks for panels grouped by model->route with these columns: P50, P95, P99, TTFT (time-to-first-token), tokens/sec, requests/sec, error-rate. need last 1h/6h/24h presets.

devin: +1. telemetry contract suggestion: metric names and labels below. please comment:

```
route_latency_seconds_bucket{le, model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id}
route_latency_seconds_sum{model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id}
route_latency_seconds_count{model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id}
route_ttft_seconds{model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id}
route_tokens_total{model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id}
route_requests_total{model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id}
route_errors_total{model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id, error_class}
```

sam: looks good. for tokens/sec we can compute rate(route_tokens_total[1m]) / rate(route_requests_total[1m]) or tokens/sec per route via `increase(route_tokens_total(5m)) / 300` depending on panel.

ravi: runtime will start emitting those for Dedicated and Hosted. for Private we can provide the schema and an agent to translate. timeline: staged rollout next 2 weeks for high-volume routes, full rollout in 4 weeks.

maria: can Console team start prototyping Grafana panels with mock metrics? we'll need templates to show stakeholders.

elaine: yes. sample PromQL for P95 (approx from histogram):
```
# P95 from histogram
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(route_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_family, route_hash, env, rollout_id))
```
and TTFT panel: `avg(route_ttft_seconds) by (model_family, route_hash)`

devin: alerting/SLIs question: do we want SLOs tied to model_family or route_hash? Product suggests SLO at route level with fallbacks to model_family if route lacks volume.

maria: yes route-level primary, model_family fallback. Console should show which level an SLO is evaluated at.

sam: operational note: add `sampling_rate` metric or tag so we can factor sampling into dashboard math when telemetry is downsampled.

ravi: will add an emit `route_metric_sampling{route_hash, value}` with value between 0 and 1.

devin: ownership: infra owns emit + schema, eng-platform owns ingestion/aggregation and retention policies, console owns panel templates + UX. action items:
- infra (ravi): add metrics and sampling emit, roll high-volume routes in 2 weeks.
- product (maria): share top-200 routes CSV and SLO definitions.
- console (elaine): prototype panels and send mock screenshots.
- eng-platform (sam/devin): define ingest flags for cardinality and retention, confirm Prometheus/Grafana queries.

maria: I'll upload CSV in #eng-platform and ping here.

console-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard-template branch created: `dashboards/route-slo-v1` :white_check_mark:

sam: i'll start drafting the ingest contract doc with explicit label types and retention rules. will post PR in infra-internal.

ravi: one more: for cold routes we should default to a 99th-percentile smoothing window (e.g., 6h) to avoid noise. add as note in Console UX.

elaine: noted, will add smoothing toggle.

devin: perfect. thanks everyone — i'll follow up with a tidy contract doc and the action-item tracker. :thumbsup:
